title: NetSage
summary: A local-first, rule-based Android application that maps network symptoms and logs to ranked candidate causes, matched evidence, and troubleshooting actions.
features: History, favorites, report copy, and command templates
Offline reference, privacy onboarding, and local persistence
implementation: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose Android client
Rule-based diagnosis with explicit evidence mapping
SharedPreferences and Gson for local persistence
Retained FastAPI health and diagnosis endpoints
limitations: The diagnostic engine is rule-based, not a machine-learning model.
No verified real-user performance metrics are published.
Cloud synchronization, PDF export, and real-time packet capture are outside the verified scope.

facts.publicText: Ranks up to three candidate causes using rule-derived confidence values, matched evidence, and suggested actions
